export type Bytes = Bytes
export type ByteBuffer = ByteBuffer

export record TypeValue {
  kind: string,
  name: string,
  value: string,
  identity: string,
  origin: string,
  arguments: Array<TypeValue>,
  members: Array<TypeValue>,
  fieldNames: Array<string>,
  fields: Array<TypeValue>,
  parameters: Array<TypeValue>,
  variadic: Array<TypeValue>,
  result: Array<TypeValue>,
}

// Advice for removed spellings. The checker and resolver own binding and edition checks.
export function removedStaticHint(namespace: string, member: string) -> string {
  match "{namespace}.{member}" {
    case "Array.of" => "use [a, b]"
    case "Set.of" => "use set \{ a, b \}"
    case "Map.new" => "use map \{\}"
    case "Bytes.encodeUtf8" => "use s.encodeUtf8()"
    case "Bytes.concat" => "use a.concat(b)"
    case "BigInt.fromInt" => "use n.toBigInt()"
    case "Decimal.fromInt" => "use n.toDecimal()"
    case "Math.sqrt" => "use x.sqrt()"
    case "Math.abs" => "use x.abs()"
    case "Math.floor" => "use x.floor() for int, or x.floor().toFloat() for float"
    case "Math.ceil" => "use x.ceil() for int, or x.ceil().toFloat() for float"
    case "Math.round" => "use x.round() for int, or x.round().toFloat() for float"
    case "Math.sin" => "use x.sin()"
    case "Math.cos" => "use x.cos()"
    case "Math.tan" => "use x.tan()"
    case "Math.isNaN" => "use x.isNaN()"
    case "Math.isFinite" => "use x.isFinite()"
    case "Math.parseFloat" => "use s.parseFloat()"
    case "Math.min" => "use a.atMost(b)"
    case "Math.max" => "use a.atLeast(b)"
    case "JSON.parse" => "import std.json and use json.parse(s)"
    case "JSON.stringify" => "import std.json and use json.stringify(v)"
    case "JSON.parseAs" => "import std.json and use json.parseAs<T>(s)"
    case "JSON.decode" => "use v.decode<T>()"
    case "TOML.toJson" => "use t.toJson()"
    case "Encoding.utf8Encode" => "use s.encodeUtf8()"
    case "Encoding.utf8Decode" => "use b.decodeUtf8()"
    case "Encoding.hexEncode" => "use b.toHex()"
    case "Encoding.hexDecode" => "use Bytes.fromHex(s)"
    case "Encoding.base64Encode" => "use b.toBase64()"
    case "Encoding.base64Decode" => "use Bytes.fromBase64(s)"
    case "Hash.sha256" => "use b.sha256()"
    case "Hash.sha512" => "use b.sha512()"
    case "Hash.hmacSha256" => "use key.hmacSha256(data)"
    case "Hash.crc32" => "use b.crc32()"
    case "Cli.hasFlag" => "use args.hasFlag(name)"
    case "Cli.option" => "use args.option(name)"
    case "Cli.options" => "use args.options(name)"
    case "Cli.positionals" => "use args.positionals()"
    case "Codec.gzipCompress" => "use b.gzipCompress()"
    case "Codec.gzipDecompress" => "use b.gzipDecompress()"
    case "Codec.deflateCompress" => "use b.deflateCompress()"
    case "Codec.deflateFixedCompress" => "use b.deflateFixedCompress()"
    case "Codec.zlibFixedCompress" => "use b.zlibFixedCompress()"
    case "Codec.reedSolomon255223Protect" => "use b.reedSolomon255223Protect()"
    case "Codec.deflateDecompress" => "use b.deflateDecompress()"
    case "Codec.zstdDecompress" => "use b.zstdDecompress()"
    case "Codec.zstdCompress" => "use b.zstdCompress(level)"
    case "FS.readText" => "import std.fs and use fs.readText(p)"
    case "FS.writeText" => "import std.fs and use fs.writeText(p, text)"
    case "FS.readBytes" => "import std.fs and use fs.readBytes(p)"
    case "FS.writeBytes" => "import std.fs and use fs.writeBytes(p, bytes)"
    case "FS.list" => "import std.fs and use fs.list(p)"
    case "CSV.parse" => "import std.csv and use csv.parse(s)"
    case "CSV.parseWithHeader" => "import std.csv and use csv.parseWithHeader(s)"
    case "CSV.stringify" => "import std.csv and use csv.stringify(rows)"
    case "CSV.stringifyWithHeader" => "import std.csv and use csv.stringifyWithHeader(rows, columns)"
    case "TOML.parse" => "import std.toml and use toml.parse(s)"
    case "TOML.stringify" => "import std.toml and use toml.stringify(v)"
    case "TOML.fromJson" => "import std.toml and use toml.fromJson(v)"
    case "Test.assert" => "import std.test and use test.assert(condition)"
    case "Test.assertEq" => "import std.test and use test.assertEq(a, b)"
    case "Test.assertNe" => "import std.test and use test.assertNe(a, b)"
    case "Test.assertContains" => "import std.test and use test.assertContains(text, part)"
    case "Test.assertOk" => "import std.test and use test.assertOk(result)"
    case "Test.assertErr" => "import std.test and use test.assertErr(result)"
    case "Test.assertSome" => "import std.test and use test.assertSome(option)"
    case "Test.assertNone" => "import std.test and use test.assertNone(option)"
    case "Test.assertGolden" => "import std.test and use test.assertGolden(name, actual)"
    case _ => ""
  }
}

export function removedModuleHint(module: string) -> string {
  match module {
    case "std.math" => "; use float receiver methods such as x.sqrt(), a.atMost(b), a.atLeast(b), and s.parseFloat() in 5.21"
    case "std.encoding" => "; use s.encodeUtf8(), b.decodeUtf8(), b.toHex(), Bytes.fromHex(s), b.toBase64(), and Bytes.fromBase64(s) in 5.21"
    case "std.hash" => "; use b.sha256(), b.sha512(), key.hmacSha256(data), and b.crc32() in 5.21"
    case "std.codec" => "; use Bytes receiver methods such as b.gzipCompress() and b.zstdCompress(level) in 5.21"
    case "std.cli" => "; use args.hasFlag(name), args.option(name), args.options(name), and args.positionals() in 5.21"
    case "std.gen" => "; use [for x in lo..hi => x] and [false, true] in 5.21"
    case _ => ""
  }
}

// Runtime-callable static namespace members. Generic schema calls belong to
// the type-directed surface and never enter this catalog.
export function staticBuiltin(namespace: string, member: string) -> string {
  match staticSpec(namespace, member) {
    case Some(spec) => spec.tag
    case None => ""
  }
}

export function freeBuiltin(name: string) -> string {
  match name {
    case "print" => "Print"
    case "toInt" => "ToInt"
    case "toIntRadix" => "ToIntRadix"
    case "fromCodePoint" => "FromCodePoint"
    case "toFloat" => "ToFloat"
    case "input" => "Input"
    case "map" => "MapFn"
    case "filter" => "FilterFn"
    case "reduce" => "ReduceFn"
    case "open" => "Open"
    case "assert" => "TestAssert"
    case _ => ""
  }
}

// Runtime operations a generated std.lispex module names directly: the same
// module and name pairs as the Rust emitter's `lispex_intrinsic_kind`.
export function lispexIntrinsic(module: string, name: string) -> string {
  match "{module}::{name}" {
    case "std.fs::__stdReadText" => "FsReadText"
    case "std.fs::__stdWriteText" => "FsWriteText"
    case "std.fs::__stdReadBytes" => "FsReadBytes"
    case "std.fs::__stdWriteBytes" => "FsWriteBytes"
    case "std.fs::__stdList" => "FsList"
    case "std.io::__stdWriteLine" => "Print"
    case "std.io::__stdReadStdin" => "Input"
    case "std.io::__stdOpen" => "Open"
    case "std.json::__stdJsonParse" => "JsonParse"
    case "std.json::__stdJsonStringify" => "JsonStringify"
    case "std.json::__stdJsonParseAs" => "JsonParseAs"
    case "std.csv::__stdCsvParse" => "CsvParse"
    case "std.csv::__stdCsvParseWithHeader" => "CsvParseWithHeader"
    case "std.csv::__stdCsvStringify" => "CsvStringify"
    case "std.csv::__stdCsvStringifyWithHeader" => "CsvStringifyWithHeader"
    case "std.toml::__stdTomlParse" => "TomlParse"
    case "std.toml::__stdTomlStringify" => "TomlStringify"
    case "std.toml::__stdTomlFromJson" => "TomlFromJson"
    case "std.test::__stdAssert" => "TestAssert"
    case "std.test::__stdAssertEq" => "TestAssertEq"
    case "std.test::__stdAssertNe" => "TestAssertNe"
    case "std.test::__stdAssertContains" => "TestAssertContains"
    case "std.test::__stdAssertOk" => "TestAssertOk"
    case "std.test::__stdAssertErr" => "TestAssertErr"
    case "std.test::__stdAssertSome" => "TestAssertSome"
    case "std.test::__stdAssertNone" => "TestAssertNone"
    case "std.test::__stdAssertGolden" => "TestAssertGolden"
    case "std.typeset::__lengthFromScaledPoints" => "LengthFromScaledPoints"
    case "std.typeset::__lengthFromMilliPoints" => "LengthFromMilliPoints"
    case "std.lispex.rules::__lispexRule" => "LispexRule"
    case "std.lispex::__lispexValueFromCanonical" => "LispexValueFromCanonical"
    case "std.lispex::__lispexCanonicalBytes" => "LispexCanonicalBytes"
    case "std.lispex::__lispexDefaultLimits" => "LispexDefaultLimits"
    case "std.lispex::__lispexInspectRule" => "LispexInspectRule"
    case "std.lispex::__lispexEvaluate" => "LispexEvaluate"
    case "std.lispex::__lispexEvaluateWithEvidence" => "LispexEvaluateWithEvidence"
    case "std.lispex::__lispexConsumerArtifactFromBytes" => "LispexConsumerArtifactFromBytes"
    case "std.lispex::__lispexConsumerArtifactBytes" => "LispexConsumerArtifactBytes"
    case "std.lispex::__lispexPortableCoreBytes" => "LispexPortableCoreBytes"
    case "std.lispex::__lispexInspectConsumerArtifact" => "LispexInspectConsumerArtifact"
    case "std.lispex::__lispexVerifyConsumerArtifact" => "LispexVerifyConsumerArtifact"
    case "std.lispex::__lispexFreshReplay" => "LispexFreshReplay"
    case _ => ""
  }
}

// Free scalar/host leaves retain their direct ABI; callback builtins and open
// use the existing callable runtime dispatch.
export function freeSpec(name: string) -> Option<BuiltinSpec> {
  if name == "assert" { return staticSpec("Test", "assert") }
  let leaf = match name {
    case "print" => "builtin_print"
    case "input" => "builtin_input"
    case "toInt" => "builtin_to_int"
    case "toIntRadix" => "builtin_to_int_radix"
    case "fromCodePoint" => "builtin_from_code_point"
    case "toFloat" => "builtin_to_float"
    case _ => ""
  }
  if leaf == "" { return None }
  let params = match name {
    case "print" => ["value"]
